title: NEVER-WORDS OUT OF RAID TEXT
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD and uses one word for each thing, his vocabulary. The internal names leaked onto the screen: a ping on a Crier read SNITCH (and CHOIR for a Pillbox, STRAY for the Survivor), a dead Crier was labelled SNITCH DOWN, a machine wreck prompted SEARCH BOTWRECK, the Peddler cache read PEDLAR STOCK, the field guide said CHOIR, and the Current Pillagers board counted the dead as down. A ping now names the CRIER, PILLBOX, SURVIVOR or THE PEDDLER with no colon label, a machine is DESTROYED and a person ELIMINATED, a wreck prompts SEARCH WRECK, the cache reads PEDDLER STOCK, the guide says PILLBOX and the board reads 2 dead. The internal names stay in the code.
now: Pings, kill labels, the wreck prompt, the Peddler cache and the pillager board use the names you know: CRIER, PILLBOX, WRECK, DESTROYED and dead.
